data.name: SqlSelectCommand1.CommandText
data.value: SELECT LocationID, LocationGuid, QuoteGuid, LocationNo, BuildingNo, PhysicalBuildingNo, Address1, Address2, City, State, County, Zip, ZipPlus, ConstructionID, ProtectionCode, AddnInformation, SqFootage, EQZone, FloodZone, EQConstruction, WindCoverage, Territory, TaxTerritory, Inspect, Photo, Diagram, CostEstimator, UserAdded, DateAdded, DistToFireHydrant, DistToFireStation, FireDistrict, Stories, Basements, Elevators, YearBuilt, WiringYear, RoofingYear, PlumbingYear, HeatingYear, ModificationCode, InspectionCompanyID, InspectionContact, InspectionContactPhone, Comments, ClassCodeID, FireAlarmTypeID, BurglarAlarmTypeID, LockedAndSecured, SprinklerTypeID, Vacant, WindRestrictionID, GEOPhyBuildNum, GEOAddress1, GEOAddress2, GEOCity, GEOState, GEOCounty, GEOZip, GEOZipPlus, RecCheck, Rush, DueDate, Latitude, Longitude, GeoStatus, GeoURL, (SELECT TOP (1) BaseLocationId FROM tblUnderwritingLocationsLookup AS ULL WHERE (LocationId = UL.LocationID)) AS BaseLocationId, LocationLookup, RoofInspectionCompanyID, ContactEmail FROM tblUnderwritingLocations AS UL WHERE (LocationID = COALESCE (@LocationID, LocationID)) AND (QuoteGuid = @QuoteGuid) ORDER BY LocationNo, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(BuildingNo) = 1 THEN CONVERT(BIGINT, BuildingNo) ELSE 9000 END

data.name: SqlUpdateCommand1.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE tblUnderwritingLocations SET LocationGuid = @LocationGuid, QuoteGuid = @QuoteGuid, LocationNo = @LocationNo, BuildingNo = @BuildingNo, PhysicalBuildingNo = @PhysicalBuildingNo, Address1 = @Address1, Address2 = @Address2, City = @City, State = @State, County = @County, Zip = @Zip, ZipPlus = @ZipPlus, ConstructionID = @ConstructionID, ProtectionCode = @ProtectionCode, AddnInformation = @AddnInformation, SqFootage = @SqFootage, EQZone = @EQZone, FloodZone = @FloodZone, EQConstruction = @EQConstruction, WindCoverage = @WindCoverage, Territory = @Territory, TaxTerritory = @TaxTerritory, Inspect = @Inspect, Photo = @Photo, Diagram = @Diagram, CostEstimator = @CostEstimator, UserAdded = @UserAdded, DateAdded = @DateAdded, DistToFireHydrant = @DistToFireHydrant, DistToFireStation = @DistToFireStation, FireDistrict = @FireDistrict, Stories = @Stories, Basements = @Basements, Elevators = @Elevators, YearBuilt = @YearBuilt, WiringYear = @WiringYear, RoofingYear = @RoofingYear, PlumbingYear = @PlumbingYear, HeatingYear = @HeatingYear, ModificationCode = @ModificationCode, InspectionCompanyID = @InspectionCompanyID, InspectionContact = @InspectionContact, InspectionContactPhone = @InspectionContactPhone, Comments = @Comments, ClassCodeID = @ClassCodeID, FireAlarmTypeID = @FireAlarmTypeID, BurglarAlarmTypeID = @BurglarAlarmTypeID, LockedAndSecured = @LockedAndSecured, SprinklerTypeID = @SprinklerTypeID, Vacant = @Vacant, WindRestrictionID = @WindRestrictionID, GEOPhyBuildNum = @GEOPhyBuildNum, GEOAddress1 = @GEOAddress1, GEOAddress2 = @GEOAddress2, GEOCity = @GEOCity, GEOState = @GEOState, GEOCounty = @GEOCounty, GEOZip = @GEOZip, GEOZipPlus = @GEOZipPlus, RecCheck = @RecCheck, Rush = @Rush, DueDate = @DueDate, Latitude = @Latitude, Longitude = @Longitude, GeoStatus = @GeoStatus, GeoURL = @GeoURL, LocationLookup = @LocationLookup, RoofInspectionCompanyID = @RoofInspectionCompanyID, ContactEmail = @ContactEmail WHERE (LocationID = @Original_LocationID); SELECT LocationID, LocationGuid, QuoteGuid, LocationNo, BuildingNo, PhysicalBuildingNo, Address1, Address2, City, State, County, Zip, ZipPlus, ConstructionID, ProtectionCode, AddnInformation, SqFootage, EQZone, FloodZone, EQConstruction, WindCoverage, Territory, TaxTerritory, Inspect, Photo, Diagram, CostEstimator, UserAdded, DateAdded, DistToFireHydrant, DistToFireStation, FireDistrict, Stories, Basements, Elevators, YearBuilt, WiringYear, RoofingYear, PlumbingYear, HeatingYear, ModificationCode, InspectionCompanyID, InspectionContact, InspectionContactPhone, Comments, ClassCodeID, FireAlarmTypeID, BurglarAlarmTypeID, LockedAndSecured, SprinklerTypeID, Vacant, WindRestrictionID, GEOPhyBuildNum, GEOAddress1, GEOAddress2, GEOCity, GEOState, GEOCounty, GEOZip, GEOZipPlus, RecCheck, Rush, DueDate, Latitude, Longitude, GeoStatus, GeoURL, (SELECT TOP (1) BaseLocationId FROM dbo.tblUnderwritingLocationsLookup AS ULL WHERE (LocationId = UL.LocationID)) AS BaseLocationId, LocationLookup, RoofInspectionCompanyID FROM dbo.tblUnderwritingLocations AS UL WHERE (LocationID = @LocationID) ORDER BY LocationNo, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(BuildingNo) = 1 THEN CONVERT (INT , BuildingNo) ELSE 9000 END

SELECT LocationID, LocationGuid, QuoteGuid, LocationNo, BuildingNo, PhysicalBuildingNo, Address1, Address2, City, State, County, Zip, ZipPlus, ConstructionID, ProtectionCode, AddnInformation, SqFootage, EQZone, FloodZone, EQConstruction, WindCoverage, Territory, TaxTerritory, Inspect, Photo, Diagram, CostEstimator, UserAdded, DateAdded, DistToFireHydrant, DistToFireStation, FireDistrict, Stories, Basements, Elevators, YearBuilt, WiringYear, RoofingYear, PlumbingYear, HeatingYear, ModificationCode, InspectionCompanyID, InspectionContact, InspectionContactPhone, Comments, ClassCodeID, FireAlarmTypeID, BurglarAlarmTypeID, LockedAndSecured, SprinklerTypeID, Vacant, WindRestrictionID, GEOPhyBuildNum, GEOAddress1, GEOAddress2, GEOCity, GEOState, GEOCounty, GEOZip, GEOZipPlus, RecCheck, Rush, DueDate, Latitude, Longitude, GeoStatus, GeoURL, (SELECT TOP (1) BaseLocationId FROM dbo.tblUnderwritingLocationsLookup AS ULL WHERE (LocationId = UL.LocationID)) AS BaseLocationId, LocationLookup, RoofInspectionCompanyID FROM dbo.tblUnderwritingLocations AS UL WHERE (LocationID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()) ORDER BY LocationNo, CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(BuildingNo) = 1 THEN CONVERT (INT , BuildingNo) ELSE 9000 END
